messages.text: I applied for a refund on my seat cushion while I was still within the deadline, but the staff member rejected it. Surely that first request keeps my refund window open?

messages.text:
No. Although the first proposal was created within the 30-day window, a rejected proposal does not keep the window open for a later request. The policy’s exception for an earlier timely proposal excludes proposals rejected by staff, so a new request made after the deadline would be refused as late (refund-policy/v2/window).

The shop’s records show your seat cushion was received back and has not been refunded (refund-policy/v2/return; refund-policy/v2/remaining).
